title: Nonemptiness of the Low-Degree Fourier Family
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $P$ be a subset of an $n$-element index set. The family of subsets of the indices outside $P$ having size at most $\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$ is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of an $n$-element index set
